title: Human-facing commands and setup
scope: Research evidence read from source on 2026-10-12; each record states what it checked. Revalidate before relying on it as live behavior.

records.title: Agent-led help: /yoke help and planned yoke-global help
records.name: Agent-led help: /yoke help and planned yoke-global help
records.audience: Human asking an agent, with the agent selecting the right deeper instruction
records.scope: Project help inside a wired project; global help outside one
records.trigger: User asks how to use Yoke, invokes help, or needs a missing-project recovery path
records.current: /yoke help exists and prints a broad generated skill table plus terminal recipes. yoke-global is planned in FIRST-USER P4, not established here as shipped.
records.proposed_purpose: Translate the person’s intent into one useful action and its canonical instructions.
content: If the user gave a task, answer that task with one recommended route.
If they asked generally, offer a short choice: start a project, plan work, run work, check progress, review a decision, or get unstuck.
Name where the action belongs: this project folder, another project folder, or the global session.
Explain only the unfamiliar term needed for that action.
Offer the relevant manual section and exact skill/help pointer when more detail is wanted.

scope_variants.outsideProject: Show accessible projects or create/add a project; carry the chosen intent into the actual folder before /yoke onboard or item execution.
scope_variants.insideProject: Use current project facts and the item’s pinned workflow to route; do not require the user to memorize stage commands.

records.authority_and_reuse: The skill is a router to canonical skill bodies, docs and generated command reference, not another command catalog or a second set of operating rules.
records.proposal_status: Modify existing project help; planned global skill carries the global variant

records.title: Return-to-work panels / concise session orientation
records.name: Return-to-work panels / concise session orientation
records.audience: Returning human operator; agent reading live continuity first
records.scope: Global summary outside a project; project/item summary inside one
records.trigger: User returns or asks what to do next; at startup the agent receives facts and surfaces human text only when useful/actionable
records.proposed_purpose: Restore orientation and resume safely without repeating the introductory course.
content: Where you are: universe and selected project or no project.
What is active, waiting on you, blocked, or recently completed, with titles rather than bare IDs.
For interrupted work: last durable checkpoint, current holder/lane, evidence state and the live next-step pointer.
For a decision: say whether it approves work, reviews QA evidence or accepts a deployment.
For a missing prerequisite: one reason and one action/help link at the point it matters.
For a nearly finished initiative: offer a completion/evidence audit and deferred-work review before archival.

scope_variants.global: A short cross-project status plus the right project/folder link. Cross-project coordination does not switch an existing session’s project.
scope_variants.project: Current plan, active work, personal Inbox and delivery state; links to their existing pages rather than repeating them all.
scope_variants.noneActive: Offer to select ready work or steer the current plan; do not imply Feed must precede Steer.

records.authority_and_reuse: Reuse orientation, durable checkpoints, Frontier/Sessions/Inbox/Shipping, and the existing onboarding panel. No separate progress database or prescribed multi-stage tour. Unreadable facts stay unknown; preference and cue-dedup policy remains an open JOURNEYS decision.
records.proposal_status: Proposed future human rendering of current/planned context facts; archival completion audit is explicitly planned

records.title: Agent-assisted setup conversation and receipt
records.name: Agent-assisted setup conversation and receipt
records.audience: Human with an agent operating setup
records.scope: Machine/global until project selection; project onboarding only in the selected folder
records.trigger: User asks the agent to install Yoke or resume installation
records.proposed_purpose: Let the agent handle routine work and explain only the choice the human needs to make.
content: Begin with the person’s practical constraint: just this computer, several computers, or a team.
Translate each real setup decision into one short recommendation and reason.
Reuse existing configuration and make consequential replacement/import choices explicit.
Distinguish GitHub access from optional issue sync; leave sync off unless the user intentionally enables it.
Explain sign-in, device authorization and harness trust only when the human must act.
Verify the active harness, registration and hooks; show a plain repair if needed.
Carry the chosen project and existing-work intent into the correct folder, then start project onboarding there.

scope_variants.global: Choose/add/open a project via planned yoke-global; do not call project-only onboard as a global chooser.
scope_variants.matureProject: Ask what existing plans, local work, issues/PRs or transcripts should be read before synthesizing CURRENT-PLAN.
scope_variants.otherScm: Explain the supported GitHub-integration boundary, then continue with it skipped; do not promise another provider integration.

records.authority_and_reuse: Same setup engine and resumable facts as TUI, using planned structured agent-mode responses. Human prose is a short rendering of that state, not a second setup implementation.
records.proposal_status: Depends on planned agent-mode/global-context mechanics; not claimed to be current behavior

records.title: Interactive terminal setup
records.name: Interactive terminal setup
records.scope: Machine/universe first; optional project selection later
records.proposed_purpose: Complete necessary setup with the fewest decisions and an unambiguous handoff.
content: At the mode choice, say which computers can reach this universe: this machine only, your server, or Yoke Cloud.
At an identity/browser step, say why the browser opens, what to approve and how to return.
Allow a project now or later; when chosen, distinguish an existing checkout from a new project.
Keep GitHub integration optional. Silently keep item-to-issue sync off; no sync-choice screen.
Run routine checks automatically; show one plain repair step only when something needs attention.
End with the connected mode/universe, actual project or no project, active-harness readiness, and one concrete next action.

scope_variants.noProject: Finish machine setup; explain how to ask the agent to choose/add a project later.
scope_variants.projectChosen: Open that actual folder in the active harness and continue the existing onboarding handoff.
scope_variants.githubSkipped: Report skipped GitHub-dependent checks as not applicable, not setup failure.

records.authority_and_reuse: Use the existing setup state machine and its resumable steps. Longer explanations link to the manual; no workflow/QA/infrastructure course inside the TUI.
records.proposal_status: Proposed post-plan presentation; applies later user corrections over the older captured item 10/C/E wording

records.title: Top-level terminal help: yoke help / yoke --help
records.name: Top-level terminal help: yoke help / yoke --help
records.audience: Human terminal users and agents discovering commands
records.scope: Global; usable without a project or completed setup
records.trigger: Explicit help request; bare yoke after valid machine configuration
records.current: Both spellings already work and print the same large generated command catalog. Bare yoke first checks machine configuration and may route to setup. yoke help TOPIC is not currently topic routing; yoke <group> --help is.
records.proposed_purpose: Answer what to do next and how to find exact commands in one screen.
content: One sentence: Yoke keeps plans, work, proof and delivery together while agents do the work.
Set up this machine: yoke setup.
Check your current connection and checkout: yoke status.
Open the workbench: yoke ui.
Work with an agent: distinguish /yoke help in a project from the planned global project chooser.
Find exact commands with yoke <group> --help and the full generated command reference; link the overview, contents and troubleshooting.

scope_variants.outsideProject: Name that project selection is separate from universe selection; point to choose/add/open, without failing help.
scope_variants.insideProject: Point to project status and the project help route; do not print its full live state or secrets into root help.

records.authority_and_reuse: Keep command names/usages generated from the existing registry. Preserve the exhaustive catalog behind an explicit discoverable route; decide that route rather than inventing a flag in documentation. Keep help usable offline without mandatory server reads.
records.proposal_status: New presentation proposal using existing command/help mechanisms
